annotations.text: Lead direction: Paper & Vermilion. Warm editorial, the tree drawn with the same pill nodes the app already uses, one vermilion accent. Bracketed values like [N] and [YEAR] are placeholders for real numbers.

Two alternate directions, hero only. Lantern Night: dark, glowing nodes, more ceremony, but harder to carry into a dense tree view. Club Poster: loud, lin-colored bands, student-club energy, but the heavy borders and pills fight the graph. Pick one and the rest of the site follows.
Style guide for the whole site: tokens, type, and the components that already exist in the app (person node, lin tabs, badges). Same values are written up in designs/README.md for the codebase.

Three more takes in the spirit of Club Poster. B1 Sticker Sheet: tilted die-cut pills, hard shadows, dotted paper, the most playful; risk is looking like a kids' brand if overdone. B2 Zine: taped polaroids, typewriter labels, halftone photos, leans on real member photos to work. B3 Festival Poster: full-bleed vermilion, cream and gold, nodes hung like lanterns, the most CSA-specific; a red page needs care so the tree view stays readable.
